invariants.rationale: Context is being cast and passed to another class; it should not be null.
instantTime is passed to the executor and likely represents a timestamp that should not be null.
hoodieRecords is passed to another method and represents records to upsert; should not be null.
instantTime should be a non-empty string to represent a meaningful instant.
hoodieRecords should always be a List, as per the method signature.
